# AgentBuyNetwork - Full Network Index

> A growing network of independent indexes, one per category, listing sellers and data sources that publish llms.txt files, public API documentation, or agent tools. For people building AI shopping agents. Listings are free and imply no affiliation, partnership, or endorsement.

## About the Network
AI agents that shop need to know which sellers they can actually read and work with. AgentBuyNetwork saves an agent, or the person building it, the step of finding and checking these sources one by one. The network is early-stage and adding categories and sources over time.

## Live Indexes (as of 2026-10-10)

| Index | Category | Sources Listed | llms.txt |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| AgentBuyParts | Auto, powersports, RV, marine, aviation, and equipment parts; vehicle fitment data | 15 | https://agentbuyparts.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuyGift | Gift retailers, gifting platforms, gift card APIs | 13 | https://agentbuygift.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuyBeer | Beer data, breweries, wine and alcohol | 7 | https://agentbuybeer.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuyCoffee | Coffee roasters and ordering | 3 | https://agentbuycoffee.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuyGold | Gold price data | 2 | https://agentbuygold.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuySilver | Silver price data | 2 | https://agentbuysilver.com/llms.txt |
| AgentBuyPhone | Phones and refurbished devices | 1 | https://agentbuyphone.com/llms.txt |

Each index also publishes /llms-full.txt with a full table and summaries.

## How Sources Are Listed
* A source is listed only if it publicly offers an llms.txt file, public API documentation, or an agent tool, and it was reachable on the date shown.
* Descriptions summarize what each company says about itself. Products, prices, and service quality are not rated, ranked, or verified.
* Listings are free. There is no affiliation, partnership, or paid relationship with any company listed.
* Each index shows its last-checked date and a "Not Yet Listed" section for well-known sellers without public machine-readable resources.

## In Development
Planned indexes, not yet live: AgentBuyAI, AgentBuyCompute, AgentBuyBTC, AgentBuyETH, AgentBuyCrypto, AgentBuyCar, AgentBuyParking, AgentBuyGroceries, AgentBuyTickets, AgentBuyTix, AgentBuyTravel.

## Recent Updates
* 2026-10-10: AgentBuyParts expanded from 8 to 15 sources, adding powersports and RV parts retailers and vehicle fitment data, including two MCP servers (FitsMyBoat and VehDB).
* 2026-10-08: All seven indexes rechecked link by link. Listings now describe only what each company publishes, outdated sources were corrected or moved to "Not Yet Listed," and each index shows a last-checked date.
